basic_info.description: Tribeca Loft meets Soma Converted Warehouse. Discover designer luxury at the Lighthouse Lofts, where historic charm blends seamlessly with modern sophistication. This exceptional live/work loft offers 1,056 sq. ft (per public record) of breathtaking space featuring soaring exposed concrete, and expansive, light-filled steel-paned windows.  Home features 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, and a stylish kitchen equipped with a Liebherr fridge and electric range. Bamboo flooring and exposed concrete highlight the industrial-chic design, while a  Whirlpool washer and dryer enhance everyday living.    Originally constructed in 1924, the building's exterior features a striking Gothic-inspired terra cotta entrance on Howard Street. Located in the heart of SoMa, this boutique elevator building offers residents amenities, including an elevator, VIEW rooftop deck with BBQ and Butterfly MX building entry system.  This offering also comes with 1 car parking and storage. City center amenities are close by: SFMOMA, Yerba Buena Gardens, Moscone Center, SalesForce Gardens, Civic Center Tech hub, Union Square, dining and nightlife, plus easy access to Caltrain, MUNI, freeways and The Bay Bridge.
